title: 第6章 戏亭分封
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

前206年，戏水西岸的军营中，项羽身披玄甲，目光如炬。他面前铺开的地图上，十八块封地如同破碎的拼图，暗藏杀机。刘邦跪接汉王印绶时，手指攥紧。田荣未获寸土，眼中寒光闪烁。三秦降将章邯、司马欣、董翳的封地像一把铁索横亘关中。这场名为“分封”的盛宴，实则是项羽精心策划的权力游戏。然而，短短八个月后，天下烽烟再起，诸侯反目，项羽的霸业急转直下。为何一场本应稳固江山的布局，却成了西楚霸王的滑铁卢？

2月，项羽主持对战后天下郡县的分封。分封为何要由项羽来主导？当然是因为他的实力最强，在强大的实力面前，不想被收拾，就只能乖乖听话。

既然是项羽主持的分封，首先必须要解决楚怀王的身份地位问题，《史记·高祖本纪》记载：【项羽乃曰：“怀王者，吾家项梁所立耳，非有攻伐，何以得主约！本定天下，诸将及籍也。”乃详尊怀王为义帝，实不用其命。】

先把楚怀王升为义帝，给他升一级，把楚王空出来，这样在“王”这个层面，大家就可以随意了。接下来当然是先封自己了，项羽也不客气，封自己为“西楚霸王”，王梁楚之地九郡，都彭城。

大家都是王，但只有项羽是霸王。这个霸王是项羽对自己的官方认证，春秋五霸的霸，诸侯之长。这是因为现在不好意思称帝，但又不甘心跟大家平起平坐，为显示高人一等，项羽特意给自己的王前面加上一个“霸”字，显得是那么霸气外露。

最有意思的就是对刘邦的分封，知道刘邦喜欢关中，就是不封给他，但又因为有“先入关中者王之”的约定，项羽和范增经过商议决定将刘邦封到巴蜀去。因为巴蜀也是秦国故地，这里与关中有秦岭横亘其间，山高路远，地势险峻，道路崎岖难行，以往都是秦国发配犯人的标准流放地，发配到这里就不用担心犯人会逃跑了，因为根本跑不出去。

项羽和范增还强词夺理说：“巴蜀也属于关中，将刘邦封在这里也属于履约，符合规定，不存在违约的问题。”

刘邦能说啥？你强你有理。

如果只有巴蜀，刘邦想再出来还真不容易，幸好有张良。在张良的争取下，他们又把汉中也封给了刘邦，正是这个决定救了刘邦。汉中对巴蜀有多重要，对争夺中原有多关键，两百年后，刘备为争夺汉中，跟曹操在这里整整打了3年。后来诸葛亮北伐中原，也是将汉中作为北伐的大本营。

刘邦被封为汉王，王巴、蜀、汉中，都南郑。

项羽将秦国故地关中一分为三，分别封给秦国的三位降将。章邯封雍王；司马欣劝降章邯有功，封塞王；董翳劝章邯降楚，封翟王。秦地被分给三位秦将，后来的关中也因此被称为“三秦大地。”项羽封三秦在关中的目的就是封堵刘邦，可是到底还是没能堵住。

好的地方项羽都想占，他把魏国的精华膏腴之地淮泗以北据为己有，然后将原来的主人魏豹封为西魏王，顾名思义就是西部魏地的王。魏豹尽管不情愿，但还是得服从分配，王河东郡，都平阳。

申阳仅仅因为是张耳的宠臣，并率先攻下河南郡，立有军功，又迎楚军于河上，被立为河南王，都洛阳。

原韩王韩成本就是韩国宗室复国，因此仍为韩王，都阳翟。

赵将司马卬攻占河内郡，封堵章邯退路，封殷王，王河内郡，都朝歌。

原赵王赵歇也被从原来的地盘赶走去代北做了代王。

赵相张耳因为人脉广、朋友多，最关键的是他追随项羽入关，虽未立军功，但人家会“喊大哥”，项羽对他印象不错，就立张耳为常山王，王赵地，治襄国。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In 206 BC, in the military camp on the west bank of the river, Xiang Yu was wearing black armor and his eyes were as bright as a torch.On the map spread out in front of him, the eighteen fiefdoms were like broken puzzle pieces, hiding murderous intent.When Liu Bang knelt down to receive the seal of the King of Han, his fingers clenched tightly.Tian Rong didn't get an inch of land, his eyes flashed with cold light.The fiefdoms of Zhang Han, Sima Xin, and Dong Yi, the surrendered generals of the Three Qin Dynasty, were like an iron rope across the pass.This feast called "enfeoffment" is actually a power game carefully planned by Xiang Yu.However, just eight months later, war broke out again, the princes turned against each other, and Xiang Yu's dominance took a turn for the worse.Why did a plan that was supposed to stabilize the country turn into a Waterloo for the overlord of Western Chu?

In February, Xiang Yu presided over the enfeoffment of counties and counties in the post-war world.Why should Xiang Yu take the lead in enfeoffment?Of course, it's because he is the strongest. In the face of powerful strength, if he doesn't want to be dealt with, he can only be obedient.

Since Xiang Yu presided over the enfeoffment, we must first resolve the status issue of King Huai of Chu. "Historical Records: The Benji of Emperor Gaozu" records: [Xiang Yu said: "King Huai, my family Xiang Liang has set up an ear. If there is no attack, how can we get the master's agreement! The world is originally determined, and all generals have their own status." Naixian respects King Huai as the righteous emperor, but his life is really unnecessary.】

First, promote King Huai of Chu to the Righteous Emperor, give him a promotion, and leave King Chu free, so that at the "king" level, everyone can do whatever they want.The next step was of course to confer title on himself first. Xiang Yu was not polite and professed himself the "Overlord of Western Chu". He was the king of the nine counties of Liang Chu, with the capital at Pengcheng.

Everyone is king, but only Xiang Yu is the overlord.This overlord is Xiang Yu's official certification of himself as the overlord of the five hegemons of the Spring and Autumn Period and the leader of the princes.This is because he is embarrassed to call himself emperor now, but he is not willing to sit on an equal footing with everyone. In order to show that he is superior to others, Xiang Yu specially added the word "Ba" in front of his king, which makes him look so domineering.

The most interesting thing is the enfeoffment of Liu Bang. Knowing that Liu Bang liked Guanzhong, they refused to enfeoff it to him. However, because of the agreement that "the first to enter Guanzhong will be the king", Xiang Yu and Fan Zeng decided to enfeoff Liu Bang to Bashu after discussion.Because Bashu is also the hometown of the Qin State. There is the Qinling Mountains between here and Guanzhong. The mountains are high, the terrain is steep, and the roads are rugged and difficult to travel. In the past, it was the standard place of exile for the Qin State to send prisoners. When you are sent here, you don’t have to worry about the prisoners escaping, because they can’t escape at all.

Xiang Yu and Fan Zeng also argued: "Bashu also belongs to Guanzhong, and sealing Liu Bang here is also a fulfillment of the contract. It complies with regulations and there is no problem of breach of contract."

What can Liu Bang say?If you are strong, you are justified.

If there was only Bashu, it would be really difficult for Liu Bang to come out again. Fortunately, Zhang Liang was there.With Zhang Liang's efforts, they also granted Hanzhong to Liu Bang. It was this decision that saved Liu Bang.How important Hanzhong was to Bashu and how critical it was to the fight for the Central Plains. Two hundred years later, Liu Bei fought with Cao Cao here for three years to fight for Hanzhong.Later, Zhuge Liang made Hanzhong the base camp of his Northern Expedition in the Central Plains.

Liu Bang was named King of Han, and the capital of Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong was Nanzheng.

Xiang Yu divided Qin's hometown Guanzhong into three parts and granted them to three surrendered generals of Qin respectively.Zhang Han was granted the title of King of Yong; Sima Xin persuaded Zhang Han to surrender and was granted the title of King of Se; Dong Yi persuaded Zhang Han to surrender to Chu and was granted the title of King of Zhai.The land of Qin was divided among three Qin generals, and later Guanzhong was called the "land of the Three Qins." Xiang Yu's purpose of sealing the Three Qins in Guanzhong was to block Liu Bang, but he still failed to block it.

Xiang Yu wanted to occupy all the good places. He took the north of Huaisi, the most fertile land of Wei, as his own, and then made the original owner Wei Bao the king of the Western Wei. As the name suggests, he was the king of the western Wei.Although Wei Bao was reluctant, he still had to obey the assignment. The capital of Wang Hedong County was Pingyang.

Just because Shen Yang was Zhang Er's favorite, he took the lead in conquering Henan County, achieved military exploits, and met the Chu army on the river, he was made king of Henan, with his capital at Luoyang.

The original Korean king Han Cheng was the Korean clan who was restored to the country, so he was still the king of Han, and his capital was Yangzhai.

Zhao general Sima Yan captured Hanoi County, blocked Zhang Han's retreat, and granted him the title of King of Yin.

The original king of Zhao, Zhao Xie, was also driven away from his original territory and went to Daibei to become the acting king.

Zhang Er, Prime Minister of Zhao, had a wide network and many friends. The most important thing was that he followed Xiang Yu into the Pass. Although he did not achieve any military exploits, he was known as "big brother". Xiang Yu had a good impression of him, so he made Zhang Er the king of Changshan, king of Zhao land, and ruler of Xiangguo.
